summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 12.2 to Angular 13.4 with `ng update @angular/core@13 @angular/cli@13`, which ran the v13 CLI and core migrations (IE polyfill removal, tslint builder removal from angular.json, empty routerLink fix, TestBed teardown opt-out) and moved TypeScript to 4.6; @ngrx/* followed to 13.2.0. Angular 13 drops the automatic Node.js polyfills and ships platform-server as ESM, so the browser build could no longer resolve `url` through the SSR re-export that lived in src/main.ts; that export moved to a dedicated src/main.server.ts which the server target now uses. install and build pass from a clean node_modules; tests still fail exactly as at baseline, for the same pre-existing reason.
changes: ng update @angular/core@13 @angular/cli@13 bumped all @angular/* packages to 13.4.0, @angular/cli and @angular-devkit/build-angular to 13.3.11, and typescript to 4.6.4 (required by Angular 13).

CLI v13 migration removed the two `@angular-devkit/build-angular:tslint` lint targets from angular.json; that builder no longer exists in v13, so `npm run lint` is now a no-op target that errors (tslint itself was already deprecated and stays in optionalDependencies untouched).
CLI v13 migration stripped the IE-only polyfill comment blocks (classlist.js, web-animations-js) from src/polyfills.ts; Angular 13 dropped IE11 support.
CLI v13 migration added `/.angular/cache` to .gitignore for the new persistent build cache.

Core v13 migration rewrote `[routerLink]=""` to `[routerLink]="[]"` in src/app/fetch-employee/fetch-employee.component.html, keeping the Delete link clickable (in v13 an empty routerLink disables the link instead of routing to the current page).
Core v13 migration added `{ teardown: { destroyAfterEach: false } }` to initTestEnvironment in src/test.ts, opting the specs out of the new default TestBed teardown so test behaviour is unchanged.

Split the SSR entry point: `export { renderModule, renderModuleFactory } from '@angular/platform-server'` moved out of src/main.ts into a new src/main.server.ts, and angular.json's server target plus src/tsconfig.server.json now point at main.server.ts. Without this the browser build fails with "Can't resolve 'url'", because v13's webpack config no longer auto-polyfills Node core modules and v13's platform-server ESM bundle pulls in `url`. The browser bundle never used the export, and the server bundle still emits the same renderModule/renderModuleFactory exports.

Added `"types": []` to src/tsconfig.server.json, matching src/tsconfig.app.json. The server build otherwise type-checks every package under node_modules/@types and fails on @types/ws and @types/jasmine against the pinned @types/node 12; with it, `npm run build:ssr` produces dist-server/main.js again.

Removed @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader 7.1.0 and its ModuleMapLoaderModule import from src/app/app.server.module.ts. It pins peers on Angular ^7.1.4, which made a plain `npm install` fail with ERESOLVE on the regenerated lockfile, and it is a ViewEngine-only lazy-loading shim that is a no-op under Ivy (ViewEngine is fully removed in v13). The server build still works.

Bumped jasmine-core and @types/jasmine from ~3.6.0 to ~3.10.0 (the Angular 13 scaffold versions) to satisfy karma-jasmine-html-reporter's `jasmine-core >=3.8` peer, which also blocked a plain `npm install`.
Ran ng update @ngrx/store@13, moving all five @ngrx/* packages from 12.5.1 to 13.2.0; the v13 NgRx migrations found nothing to change in this app.
package-lock.json regenerated through npm; verified by deleting node_modules and running `npm install` (no --legacy-peer-deps needed any more) followed by npm run build and npm run build:ssr.
manual_followups: `npm run test` still fails exactly as at baseline: angular.json's test target lists "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so the CLI aborts with ENOENT before karma starts. Left untouched to keep this hop to the upgrade; worth fixing on its own.

`npm run lint` is now broken: the v13 migration deleted the tslint architect targets, so `ng lint` has nothing to run. The project should move to @angular-eslint and drop tslint/codelyzer from optionalDependencies.

The SSR entry is now src/main.server.ts. Nothing in the ASP.NET host calls it (Startup.cs uses UseSpa/UseAngularCliServer, never UseSpaPrerendering), so prerendering appears to be dead code; consider removing the server target and aspnet-prerendering entirely.
ModuleMapLoaderModule was removed from app.server.module.ts. It was a no-op under Ivy, but a person should confirm the SSR path (if it is ever revived) still renders lazy routes correctly.
angular.json still carries `defaultConfiguration: ""` on the build and server targets from the v12 migration. A person should decide whether the default build ought to be production.
`relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy'` is still set in src/app/app.module.ts. It is removed in Angular 15, so routerLink resolution should be checked and the option dropped before that hop.
node-sass 4.x still fails to compile its native binding on Node 16 and is skipped as an optional dependency; it is unused by the build but should be dropped or replaced with `sass`.
core-js is still pinned at ^2.6.5 and @types/node at ^12; both are stale and will need attention in a later hop.

A runtime smoke test of the CRUD screens is worth doing, since the build only proves compilation. In particular the Delete link in fetch-employee.component.html changed from `[routerLink]=""` to `[routerLink]="[]"`.
